description: This file implements Unix stream server socket management functions, including creating, checking server presence, and cleanup for a Unix domain socket.

methods.name: int is_another_server_alive(const char * path,const struct unix_stream_listen_opts * opts)
methods.description: Checks if another server is listening on the given Unix domain socket path.

methods.name: int unix_ss_create(const char * path,const struct unix_stream_listen_opts * opts,long timeout_ms,struct unix_ss_socket ** new_server_socket)
methods.description: Creates and binds a Unix domain socket at the specified path, with locking to prevent multiple servers.

methods.name: void unix_ss_free(struct unix_ss_socket * server_socket)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a Unix stream server socket, including closing socket and cleanup.

methods.name: int unix_ss_was_stolen(struct unix_ss_socket * server_socket)
methods.description: Checks if the server socket has been stolen or invalidated by comparing inode and device numbers.

ctags.name: unix_ss_create
ctags.signature: (const char * path,const struct unix_stream_listen_opts * opts,long timeout_ms,struct unix_ss_socket ** new_server_socket)
